verdict.rationale: Superpowers documents in-agent marketplace installs. Claude Code uses `/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace` plus `/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`, and Devin CLI uses the one-liner `devin plugins install obra/superpowers` with skills auto-triggering at session start. SessionStart context injection and the Antigravity session-start hook make the skills active from the first message without further setup. missing for 10: a true single command on Claude Code (it takes two steps), a uniform install path across harnesses (Codex/OpenCode rely on the agent fetching an INSTALL.md and Hermes needs a git clone, each harness installed separately), independent hands-on corroboration of the install-to-active flow.
